title: Shakira - Waka Waka *STEP BY STEP TUTORIAL* (Beginner Friendly)

method.teacher_system: The teacher first demonstrates the full choreography briefly with his own singing, then breaks it down step by step into small chunks with verbal cues, and finally practises the chunks at various speeds with the music.
method.signature: Singing improvised, comical lyrics to replace the copyrighted song during instruction

practices.what: Breaks down the opening getting-up motion with arms and chest positioning.
Uses spoken counts '5, 6, 7, 8' and vocalized sounds to establish the rhythm for the jump.
Repeats the jump sequence multiple times to reinforce muscle memory.
Demonstrates the step at a faster, normal speed to show how it fits together.
Teaches the next piece focusing on hip movement and aerobic dance style.
Compares chest and heart movement to telling a girlfriend 'this heart is your baby'.
Repeats the accumulated sequence from the top to cement learning.
Adds the next segment involving side leg extensions and arm swings.
Uses the mental image of pulling a box toward yourself while moving the pelvis.
Practises the learned choreography to the slow version of the music.
Instructs learners to check whether their weight and posture are correct during the movement.
Runs a final review of the routine to solidify everything taught in the tutorial.

adaptations.difficulty: The normal speed feels too fast after slow practice
adaptations.adjustment: Demonstrates it slightly faster first before attempting full speed

adaptations.difficulty: Doing both arm shakes and hip movements simultaneously is complex
adaptations.adjustment: Suggests focusing only on the hip movement if combining them is too hard

beliefs.belief: Breaking down movements into small, manageable parts makes super easy learning.

moments.says: The teacher introduces the Waka Waka tutorial and outlines the first steps.
The teacher tells the learner to go a little faster than normal speed.
The teacher reviews the lyrics and dance combination at slow speed.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling capable and ready to practice the Waka Waka choreography step by step.

struggles.theme: Struggling with the final high speed part

clicked.theme: Found the tutorial surprisingly easy and clear

requests.theme: Requested tutorials for various other K-pop and Bollywood choreographies

meant.theme: Enjoyed the teacher's singing and funny storytelling immensely

method.limits: The video does not show a back view or mirrored angle for the tutorial portion, and audio copyright required the teacher to dub his own singing.
